timing_definition: Sum of each campaign start to observed publication/CI confirmation. Includes analysis, preparation, review and CI wait; not CPU or agent reasoning time. Setup, inter-campaign gaps and final report lie outside these intervals.
runner_timing_limitations: 80 final native and 80 final Docker receipt elapsed values only; excludes exploratory worker compiles, repeated fixture builds and analysis. Docker values include its build/fixture overhead. Not a controlled platform benchmark.
